title: Initial Analysis
description: Compact advisory Initial Analysis output. All user-facing text values MUST be written in Indonesian. This response does not create or confirm a position or user decision.

orderbook_analysis.description: Concise observations from the initial orderbook image in Indonesian.

three_month_chart_analysis.description: Concise observations from the three-month chart in Indonesian.

six_month_chart_analysis.description: Concise observations from the six-month chart in Indonesian.

support.description: Advisory support area or level only; not a confirmed user fact.

note.description: Concise Indonesian explanation of the advisory support area.

resistance.description: Advisory resistance area or level only; not a confirmed user fact.

note.description: Concise Indonesian explanation of the advisory resistance area.

entry_area.description: Advisory entry area only; it does not create or confirm an entry.

note.description: Concise Indonesian explanation of the advisory entry area.

stop_recommendation.description: Advisory stop recommendation only; it does not set a confirmed stop loss.

note.description: Concise Indonesian explanation of the advisory stop recommendation.

target_recommendation.description: Advisory target recommendation only; it does not set a confirmed target price.

note.description: Concise Indonesian explanation of the advisory target recommendation.

probabilities.description: Compact advisory probabilities; they need not sum to 100.

trading_plan.description: Concise advisory next-step plan in Indonesian; it does not execute a decision.

conclusion.description: Concise final advisory conclusion in Indonesian.
